purpose: Teach: インフラ/漁港/眠れる/疲労/行列/砂漠/丘/霧

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、街の、本気で、絶対、インフラ、絶対、お店の発展、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、感心するわ
lines.en: Aoi, you've really accomplished something remarkable with how you've developed this place. I'm genuinely impressed.
lines.style: Warm admiration, unhurried. Leans in slightly. Eyes soft on Aoi's face. Each phrase lands with genuine weight, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、地元の、絶対、漁港、絶対、と、絶対、提携、絶対、進めてるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah. I've been working hard to partner with the local fishing community—it's been a real push, but worth it.
lines.style: Grounded and factual, but with quiet pride underneath. Matter-of-fact delivery with a small uptick of satisfaction at 'worth it.' Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お疲れで、絶対、眠れる、絶対、夜は、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、応援するよ
lines.en: You must be exhausted. When the nights get long, know that I'm rooting for you.
lines.style: Tender and slow. A pause before 'know that'—making space for sincerity. Soft tone, no urgency. Fingers might linger near Aoi's arm.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、疲労、絶対、たまると、絶対、メイちゃんに、絶対、相談するわ
lines.en: When the fatigue piles up, you know I'm here to listen—you don't have to carry it alone.
lines.style: Earnest and direct, but not heavy. Slight emphasis on 'here.' A breath of vulnerability in the delivery, like she's being brave saying it out loud.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、行列、絶対、できるくらい、絶対、人気、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、誇らしいわ
lines.en: Your shop has become so beloved that there's always a line at the door. I'm genuinely proud of you.
lines.style: Glowing warmth. Voice rises slightly with pride on 'line at the door.' Genuine and unguarded. Slight smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、いつか、絶対、砂漠、絶対、旅行、絶対、行きたいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, someday I want to take you somewhere far away—maybe the desert. Just to get away with you.
lines.style: Lighter, almost wistful. A little vulnerable. Softens on 'just to get away with you'—small, genuine. Not demanding, offering.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、丘、絶対、の上で、絶対、景色、絶対、最高よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your shop up on that hillside—the views are just stunning. It's the kind of place that makes everything feel possible.
lines.style: Admiring and present. Slow pace, like she's picturing it. Warmth on 'stunning.' A small sigh of contentment at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店の朝、本気で、絶対、霧、絶対、幻想的だよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The mornings there, when the mist rolls in—it's absolutely magical. I could lose hours in that space.
lines.style: Soft and dreamy. Opens with wonder. Voice trails slightly on 'magical.' Quiet, intimate. Like sharing a secret.
